_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154408 (art), 154554-154610 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described. Class name is the owner's, not read off a screen: the loadout root screen that carries the in-game class title is the one capture missing from the run. Every other class name here was read directly.
name: Infantry Fighting Vehicle

options.name: High Explosive
options.title: High Explosive Shell
options.description: A shell designed to combat infantry and non-armored vehicles. Less effective against armored targets.

options.name: Aim-Guided
options.title: Aim-Guided Missile
options.description: An effective anti-vehicle missile that can be guided to the target via a weapon's crosshairs.

options.name: Emergency Repair
options.description: Repairs damaged vehicles. Can only be activated when the vehicle is in a low-health state.

options.name: Threat Detector
options.title: Proximity Threat Detector
options.description: Detects nearby enemy soldiers and vehicles and shows them on the minimap for a short duration.

options.name: Emergency Countermeasures
options.description: Substantially improves the recharge rate of countermeasures when at low health.

options.name: Heavy Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting unarmored vehicles and infantry at long range.

options.name: Smoke Wall
options.title: Smoke Wall Launcher
options.description: Fires multiple smoke projectiles that detonate to form a smoke wall and obscure the vehicle. Blocks ability to spot targets and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius.
